a.lede: Google has cut ties with the company behind the botnet campaign.
a.title: Google dismantles botnet secretly running on 1.3 million Android TV boxes

b.lede: Google and industry partners have dismantled the XCPE malware botnet consisting of more than 1.3 million Android TV streaming TV boxes that Google says its manufacturer intentionally infected with malware to generate revenue through cybercrime activities. [...]
b.title: Google disrupts million-device XCPE Android malware botnet, bans TV box maker
